entities.summary: Polina Sergeevna Shuvalova is a Russian chess player. She holds the FIDE titles of International Master and Woman Grandmaster. She is the 2019 World Girls U-20 Champion as well as the World Girl's U18 Champion in 2018 and 2019. As of 2023, Shuvalova has earned one of three title norms required to become a grandmaster.
